lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: Penni! You're awake! I was so scared when you stopped moving...

lines.speaker: barracuda
lines.text: You ran out of air! What were you thinking?!

lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: We got you out of the water as fast as we could.

lines.speaker: barracuda
lines.text: We hauled you all the way back here. Don't do that to us again.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to worry everyone.

lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: Just... please be more careful next time. I don't want to lose you.

lines.speaker: barracuda
lines.text: Tch. Just make sure you can breathe before you go chasing things down there.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I will. Thank you for bringing me back.
